name: Bezaleel
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: The Lord called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, and filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship, to devise cunning works, to work in gold, in silver, in brass, in cutting of stones, and in carving of timber.

note.label: Exodus 31: Bezaleel and Aholiab, and the Sabbath Sign

points: The Lord called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, and filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship; the Most High put His spirit on him to be gifted in what he did, to devise curious works in gold, silver, and brass, in cutting of stones, and in carving of wood.

note.label: Exodus 35: The Sabbath and the Willing Hearted Offering

points: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab and every wise hearted man in whom the Lord put wisdom and understanding, according to all that the Lord had commanded; they were over the cunning work of the building and were leading the men among them in how the work was done.

note.label: Exodus 36: The Wise Hearted Build the Tabernacle

points: Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half was the length of it, which is forty five inches, and a cubit and a half, which is twenty seven inches, the breadth of it, and a cubit and a half the height of it.

note.label: Exodus 37: Bezaleel Makes the Ark, the Mercy Seat, and the Holy Furniture

points: The brasen altar that Bezaleel the son of Uri had made was set before the tabernacle of the Lord, and Solomon and the congregation sought unto it. Solomon went up to that brasen altar before the Lord and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it.

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
